prompts.text: Hello, my name is Siobhan O'Sullivan and I am here for an X-ray.
Should I remove my glasses before the computed tomography scan?
I have a metal implant and need to complete the MRI safety screening.
Please tell me when to hold my breath and when I can breathe normally.
